messages:
Mike (support): customer hit repeated SSE disconnects when proxied through ALB + Cloudflare -> partial outputs, then client retries show 502s. They say it reliably stops after ~60s.
Olivia (SRE): any repro curl or client logs we can run? ALB default idle is 60s which smells like it.
Mike (support): reproducer from customer: `curl -v -N -H \"Accept: text/event-stream\" \"https://api.acme.example/v1/stream?id=abc123\"` -> server logs show stream active and server sends `:keepalive\n\n` every 20s, but client sees stop at ~60s then ERR_INCOMPLETE_CHUNKED_ENCODING. They put ALB in front and Cloudflare in front of that.
Mike (support): paste of curl output (trimmed):
```
* Connected to api.acme.example (1.2.3.4) port 443 (#0)
> GET /v1/stream?id=abc123 HTTP/1.1
> Host: api.acme.example
> Accept: text/event-stream
> User-Agent: curl/7.68.0
> 
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
< content-type: text/event-stream
< transfer-encoding: chunked
< connection: keep-alive
: keepalive\n
* read failed: Connection reset by peer
* Closing connection 0
```
Olivia (SRE): interesting they still send keepalive but connection reset. Two likely layers: ALB idle timeout or Cloudflare buffering/idling or nginx/envoy proxy buffering. Do we have their proxy config?
Mike (support): customer sent nginx proxy config: `proxy_buffering on; proxy_read_timeout 60;` also Cloudflare set to "Full (strict)" and performance features default. ALB idle timeout left at default 60.
Rahul (infra): if proxy_read_timeout=60 and ALB idle 60 both match the failure time. Also proxy_buffering on means nginx will buffer whole responses and may close upstream when buffer full or when idle timer hits. For SSE we need unbuffered streaming: `proxy_buffering off; proxy_http_version 1.1; proxy_set_header Connection \"\"; proxy_set_header Host $host; proxy_set_header X-Accel-Buffering no;` plus `proxy_read_timeout 360;` and keepalive.
Olivia (SRE): for Envoy the equivalent is `use_remote_address` + set `per_stream_buffer_limit_bytes` low and `idle_timeout: 0s` or big value; also `upstream_flush_interval` for gRPC/streaming. Cloudflare: they do not like long-lived origin responses on some plans — there's a 100s limit on some CF products for responses without data; also HTTP/2 to origin sometimes buffers. Recommend test bypassing CF (point hosts file at origin) to narrow scope.
Mike (support): customer tried bypass CF by hitting ALB directly -> stream stayed open for ~4m then dropped. So ALB likely also part of it. They increased ALB idle to 300 and saw fewer drops.
Rahul (infra): action list I recommend to customer:
1) Disable buffering at all layers: set `proxy_buffering off` and send header `X-Accel-Buffering: no`. For envoy set `copy_response_headers: false`/? use `filter_chains` to disable buffering.
2) Increase ALB/NLB idle timeout to >300s (or value matching expected longest idle gap). ALB default 60s is too low for sporadic SSE.
3) If Cloudflare must sit in front, either: enable Argo/Tunnel or set page rule to bypass performance features, or if possible, use Cloudflare workers that keep connection alive. Otherwise ask CF support and supply sample curl + tcpdump/trace.
4) Ensure origin sends a heartbeat comment every 15s: `: ping\n\n` or a small event to keep the TCP window active (important when there are long gaps between events).
5) Confirm `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` and avoid `Content-Length`. Also confirm keep-alive semantics and HTTP/1.1 on the origin-proxy hop.
Olivia (SRE): repro commands for us to run:
- curl direct to origin (via /etc/hosts override) with `-v -N` and observe duration
- curl via Cloudflare and via ALB to compare
- capture `tcpdump -i any port 443` on origin while reproducing to timestamp resets
Mike (support): customer also reported intermittent partial output — chunk trailing delay where the last chunk arrives but no newline so client-side event parser waits and eventually fails. We told them to flush after each SSE line: `fflush()` or `res.flush()` depending on framework.
Rahul (infra): also flag potential bug: some HTTP/2 proxies aggregate streams and then send GOAWAY when resource thresholds hit; check ALB metrics for active connections and 5xx counts.
Mike (support): I pushed quick config snippet to them:
```
location /v1/stream {
  proxy_pass http://upstream;
  proxy_buffering off;
  proxy_cache off;
  proxy_http_version 1.1;
  proxy_set_header Connection "";
  proxy_set_header X-Accel-Buffering no;
  proxy_read_timeout 360s;
}
```
Rahul (infra): also suggest adding `Connection: keep-alive` from client and `Keep-Alive: timeout=300, max=1000` on origin response headers to nudge some LB implementations.
Olivia (SRE): for Cloudflare specifically, ask customer to disable "Rocket Loader", "Auto Minify" and "Response Buffering" features, and test with HTTP/1.1 to origin instead of h2.
Mike (support): next steps with customer: they will apply nginx changes, bump ALB idle to 300, bypass CF for a test, and report back with `curl -v -N` traces + origin logs.
DeployBot: deploy complete to staging:streaming-fix @ 2026-03-15T14:02Z :thumbsup:
Olivia (SRE): thanks — follow up in 24h, if still flaky we'll open partner escalation with Cloudflare and check ALB access logs + tcpdump.
Mike (support): thanks all, will update when customer confirms. :thumbsup:
